verses.en: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
verses.sm: Ieremia i le rafeaga i Papelonia e O upu nei o le tusi na avatua e leremia le perofeta ai Ierusalema i e na totoe o toeaina na táfea, ma faitaulaga, ma perofeta, ma le nuu uma lava, na tāfea ia Nepukanesa mai Ierusalema i Papelonia;

verses.en: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
verses.sm: ina ua mavae ona o atu nai lerusalema o lekonia le tupu, ma le saío tamaitai, ma eunuka, ma alii o Iuta ma Ierusalema, o tufuga foi, ma e galulue i uamea.

verses.en: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
verses.sm: Na ave e Eliasa le atalii o Safana, ma Kemaria le atalii o Hilikia, o e na aauina e Setekaia le tupu o Juta i Papelonia ia Nepukanesa le tupu o Papelonia ua faapea,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o “au, le Atua o Isaraelu, i le tafeaga uma, na ou faatáfea mai lerusalema i Papelonia,

verses.en: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
verses.sm: Ia outou fai fale, ma nonofo ai; ma ia outou totóina faatoaga, ma aai ai ona fua;

verses.en: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
verses.sm: ina fai avá ia outou, ma ia fananau ai atalii ma afafine ia te outou; ia outou aumaia foi ava ma o outou atalii, ma fai ni tane ma o outou afafine, ina ia latou fananau mai tama ma teine; ia faatoateleina outou i lea mea, a E aua le faatoaitiitia.

verses.en: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verses.sm: la outou sailiili foi ia manuia le aai ua ou faatāfea ai outou; ma ia outou tatalo atu i le ALII mo lena aai; auā o lona manuia e manuia ai outou.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
verses.sm: Auā o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o “au, le Atua o Isaraelu, Aua neʻi faaseseina outou e o outou perofeta ua ia te outou, ma o outou taulāitu; aua foi neʻi faalogo i miti, ua faia talu outou;

verses.en: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: auā ua latou vavalo i le pepelo ia te outou i loʻu igoa; ou te lei aauina atu i latou, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.sm: Auā o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, A faaatoatoaina tausaga e fitugafulu i Papelonia, ona ou asiasi ai lea ia te outou, ma ou faataunuuina laʻu upu lelei ia te outou, i le faafoisia mai outou i lenei mea.

verses.en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.sm: Aua o aʻu nei, ua ou iloa manatu ua ou manatu ai ia te outou, o manatu i le manuia, a e le o le malaia, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII, e foaiina atu ja te outou le iuga e i ai le faamoemoe.

verses.en: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.sm: Ona outou valaau ai lea ia te au, e 6 foi outou ma tatalo ia te au, ou te faalogo foi ia te outou.

verses.en: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.sm: E saili mai outou ia te au, tou te maua foi, pe a outou saili mai ia te au ma outou loto atoa.

verses.en: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.sm: E maua lava aʻu e outou, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII; ou te faafoisia la outou tafeaga, ma ou faapotopotoina outou ai nuu uma, ma mea uma na ou tulia ai outou, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII; Ou te faafoisia o Papelonia, na te fasiotia i laua foi outou i le mea ua ou faatafea ai outou.

verses.en: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
verses.sm: Ua outou fai ane, Ua faatuina mo i tatou e le ALII o perofeta i Papelonia;

verses.en: Know that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.sm: o le mea lea o loo faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII ile tupu, o lé tietie i le nofoalii o Tavita, ma le nuu uma o loo nonofo i lenei aai, o outou uso ia e na le o atu faatasi ma outou i le tafeaga;

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o “au, Faauta, ou te aauina atu ia te i latou o le pelu, ma le oge, ma le faamai, ou te faia foi i latou la pei o mati e matua leaga, e le mafai ona “aina, ina ua leaga.

verses.en: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
verses.sm: Ou te tuliloa foi ia te i latou i le pelu, ma le oge, ma le faamai, ou te tuuina atu foi i latou ia faaatuatuvaleina i malo uma o le lalolagi, e fai ma faafancga, ma mea e ofo ai, ma uisa ai, ma fai aʻi luma, i nuu uma ua ou tulia ai i latou.

verses.en: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Aua ua latou le faalogo i aʻu upu, o loo fetalai mai ai ¡e ALII, na Ou avatua ia te i latou i aʻu auauna o le au perofeta, na ala aauina i latou; a ua outou le faalogo lava, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.sm: A o outou, ia outou faalogo mai i le afioga a le ALII, o outou uma o le tafeaga e na aauina atu e aʻu mai Ierusalema i Pape:onia.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o “an, le Atua o Isaraelu, ia Aapo le atalii o Kulaia, ma Setekaia le atalii o Maaseia, o e vavalo i le pepelo ia te outou i loʻu igoa, Faauta, ou te tuuina i laua i le lima o Nepukanesa le tupu i o outou luma;

verses.en: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
verses.sm: e avea foi i laua e fai aʻi faafanoga e le tafeaga uma o Iuta, o i Papelonia, e faapea, Ia faia oe e le ALII ia pei o Setekaia, ma ia pei o Aapo o e na tunua e le tupu o Papelonia i le afi;

verses.en: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: aua na la fai le mea leaga i Isaraelu, ma la mulilulua ma avā a ë sa latou tuaoi, ma la fai upu i loʻu igoa i le pepelo, na ou le poloai atu ai ia te i laua; ua ou iloa ma molimau ai, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
verses.sm: la e fai atu foi ia Semaia o le Neelami, ia faapea atu,

verses.en: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o “au, le Atua o Isaraelu, ua faapea mai, Auā ua e aumaia tusi i lou igoa i le nuu uma o loo i Ierusalema, ma Sefanaia, le atalii o Maaseia le faitaulaga, ma faitaulaga uma, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
verses.sm: Ua tofia oe e le ALII e fai ma faitaulaga e sui aʻi Ioiata le faitaulaga, ina ia faia ni e pule i le fale o le ALII, i tagata e taitoatasi ua valea, ma fai o ia e ia ma perofeta, ma ia e tuuina atu o ia i laau faamau, ma le fale puipui.

verses.en: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
verses.sm: O lenei, se a le mea ua e le aoai atu ai ia Ieremia le Anatota, o le ua fai o ia e ia ma perofeta ia te outou?

verses.en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.sm: Auā lava ua au mai ai lana feau ia te i matou i Papelonia, ua faapea mai, E tuai lenei tafeaga; ia outou fāi fale, ma nonofo ai, ma ia outou totoina faatoga, ma aai ai o latou fua.

verses.en: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.sm: Ua faitau e Sefanaia le faitaulaga lenei tusi i taliga o Ieremia le perofeta.

verses.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.sm: Ona oo mai ai lea o le afioga a le ALII ia Ieremia, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
verses.sm: la e avatu le feau ia te i latou uma o le tafeaga, ia faapea atu, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII ia Semaia, le Neelami, Ua vavalo ia te outou Sernaia, a o au, na ou le auina atu o ia, ua faatupuina foi e ia ia te outou le faatuatua i le pepelo;

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.
verses.sm: 0 le mea lea o loo faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII, Faauta, ou te taui atu ia Semaia le Neelami, ma lana fanau;e le i ai ia te ia se tasi e nofo faatasi ma lenei nuu; e le iloa foi e ia le manuia ou te faia mo loʻu nuu, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII; aua va ia tautala i le fouvale i le ALII.
